S27.01.note: The extension has no document type. Searched apps/extension for document, title and untitled. The closest is artifact cards and the artifact panel title, which fall back to "Untitled artifact" (spArtifactsUntitled in apps/extension/_locales/en/messages.json), but that is not a document.

S27.03.note: No Markdown source mode or save-as-new-version found. The artifact panel has a Preview and Code view toggle (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/artifactPanel.ts), and the Code view shows text with no editing or save found.

S27.06.note: No bold, italic, underline or link controls found. The chat composer is a plain textarea (sp-input in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts). Markdown bold and links appear only in assistant replies.

S27.07.note: Checklists render as checkboxes in assistant replies (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/markdown.ts). Bulleted and numbered lists are standard Markdown rendering. There is no control to create checklists in a document.
steps: Open the side panel and click in the chat box.
Type a request such as: make a checklist for packing a suitcase, then send it.
In the reply, find the checklist items shown with checkboxes.
Tick one box and check that the item is marked done, compared with the Expected line.
S27.07.where: Side panel chat box > ask the assistant for a checklist

S27.08.note: No insert or edit table control found in apps/extension. Tables are not shown as editable in any place searched.

S27.09.note: Images go into the chat, not into a document. The rendering of the attached thumbnail was not traced in code.
steps: Open the side panel and click the Add attachment button beside the chat box.
Click Upload from device and pick a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
Check the image appears as an attachment in the chat box before sending.
Send, and check the image is rendered in the sent message, compared with the Expected line.
S27.09.where: Side panel chat box > Add attachment button > Upload from device > choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image

S27.11.note: Code blocks and KaTeX math render in assistant replies (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/markdown.ts). Users cannot add code or equation blocks to a document.
steps: Open the side panel and click in the chat box.
Type a request such as: show a short Python function and the quadratic formula in LaTeX, then send it.
In the reply, check the code block has a Copy code button.
Check the formula is shown as typeset math and not as raw LaTeX, compared with the Expected line.
S27.11.where: Side panel chat box > ask the assistant for a code sample and a math formula

S27.12.note: No outline or heading navigation panel found in apps/extension. Searched for outline and heading terms.

S27.21.note: The menu entry is set in apps/extension/src/background.ts (translate-selection). The side panel prompt code is in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts; the line numbers in the QA ledger have moved.
steps: Open any web page with readable text and select a sentence or two.
Right-click the selection and choose Translate this.
Check that the side panel opens and the chat box is filled with a prompt to translate the selected text into your browser language.
Send the prompt and check the reply is the translation, compared with the Expected line.
S27.21.where: Web page > select some text > right-click the selection > Translate this

S27.27.note: No document editor, so no autosave or saving or saved indicator for documents was found. The only saved state found is on the options page (apps/extension/src/options.ts).

S27.28.note: No document undo or redo found. The only undo found is Undo insertion after Rewrite selection on a web page text field (spRewriteUndo in apps/extension/_locales/en/messages.json).

S27.29.note: No revision history in apps/extension. The version history component (packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/artifact-components/ArtifactVersionHistory.tsx) is not imported by the extension.

S27.34.note: No citation add, edit or bibliography control found. Source citations appear only in replies (spCitationMore in apps/extension/_locales/en/messages.json).

S27.35.note: No DOCX export found. The artifact panel Download covers only html, react, svg and mermaid types (ARTIFACT_FILE_EXTENSION in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/artifactPanel.ts). Server answer files were not traced for DOCX.

S27.36.note: No PDF export found in apps/extension. Searched for pdf and export terms. Server answer files were not traced for PDF.

S27.37.note: No Markdown file export found. The artifact panel Copy copies the source text, and Download covers only html, react, svg and mermaid types.

S27.39.note: The draft is shown as a plain-text block with To, Cc, Bcc and Subject lines inside it, not as separate email fields, so it may not match Expected.
steps: Open the side panel and click in the chat box.
Type a request such as: draft an email to a colleague about Thursday's review, then send it.
In the reply, find the section headed Email with a Copy email button.
Check that To and Subject lines are shown with the body, compared with the Expected line.
S27.39.where: Side panel chat box > ask the assistant to draft an email

S27.40.note: The extension renders email drafts as static text (apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/markdown.ts). Editable To, Subject and body fields exist only in the shared React EmailBlock (packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/markdown/EmailBlock.tsx), which the extension does not use. EmailDraft has no attachment field.
